events.subtitle: Orchard Street Jazz Festival — WKCR 85th
events.category: Intergenerational creative jazz / post-Trio 3 lineage / debut-record context
events.factual_description: Close Up presents Trio Imagination during the Orchard Street Jazz Festival on Friday, October 2, 2026, with sets at 6:30 PM and 8:00 PM at 154 Orchard Street in New York. The announced trio is David Virelles on piano, Reggie Workman on bass, and Andrew Cyrille on drums. Pi Recordings releases the trio's debut album Creative Inspirations on September 25, 2026, one week before the performance. Pi states that the group evolved from Trio 3: after saxophonist Oliver Lake retired, Cyrille and Workman invited Virelles to continue that creative lineage. The label describes the recording, made at Van Gelder Studio, as an intimate collective-improvising dialogue among the three musicians. Reggie Workman's official performance archive documents prior Trio Imagination appearances at Winter Jazzfest and the Hyde Park Jazz Festival in 2025.

en.why_it_matters: This trio is a living bridge rather than a museum piece. Workman and Cyrille carry forward the listening language they developed in Trio 3, while Virelles changes the center of gravity with a piano vocabulary shaped by Cuban rhythm, abstraction and space. One week after their first recording arrives, hearing that conversation at Close Up puts a newly documented ensemble in the kind of small room where its collective decisions can actually be heard.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is in play that weekend, build Friday evening around the early set at Close Up and let the Lower East Side do the rest. From the DMV, I would fold it into a New York trip rather than make a same-day round trip for this date alone.

es.why_it_matters: Este trío funciona como un puente vivo, no como una pieza de museo. Workman y Cyrille prolongan el lenguaje de escucha que construyeron en Trio 3, mientras Virelles desplaza el centro de gravedad con un piano atravesado por ritmo cubano, abstracción y espacio. Una semana después de que aparezca su primera grabación, escuchar esa conversación en Close Up pone a un ensamble recién documentado en una sala lo bastante pequeña como para oír de verdad sus decisiones colectivas.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York está en juego ese fin de semana, armaría el viernes alrededor del set temprano en Close Up y dejaría que el Lower East Side complete la noche. Desde el DMV lo integraría a un viaje a Nueva York, en vez de hacer ida y vuelta el mismo día sólo por esta fecha.
